description: This file defines the ProjectDecorator class, a decorator for the Project entity within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to set customer information and project administrators, as well as remove administrators, encapsulating behaviors related to project management enhancements.

classes.name: ProjectDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing additional behaviors and management functions for the Project entity, including setting customers, adding/removing project admins, and interacting with ORM references.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a Project entity.

methods.name: setCustomerById
methods.description: Assigns a Customer to the project by customer ID using ORM reference.

methods.name: setProjectAdminsByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Adds multiple Employee entities as project admins based on their employee numbers.

methods.name: addProjectAdmin
methods.description: Adds a single Employee as a project admin if not already added.

methods.name: removeProjectAdmins
methods.description: Removes all project admins from the project.
